formula: EV per pack = dead × (1 − 1/odds) + chase × (1/odds). Box EV = pack EV × box packs. ETB EV = pack EV × ETB packs + optional promo dollars.

det1.note: Detective Pikachu is a special product. Type the pack count on the box you are pricing.

notes: Pull rates are unpublished. Each set's dead value, chase odds, and chase value live in data/sets.json (evDeadUsd, evChaseOdds, evChaseUsd) and stay editable.
Box and ETB numbers are pack counts, not pull rates. English booster boxes are 36 packs unless an override says otherwise. ETB size follows the series map above.
Eras without an ETB entry (Base through Black & White) have no ETB row until you type a pack count.
Promo cards inside an ETB are not priced. Add a promo dollar amount on the calculator if you want them in ETB EV. Default is $0.
Sold prices are never invented. EV/cost uses a per-set cost you type, a board-wide cost, or an optional MSRP hint that is labeled as MSRP rather than market.
